description.zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。
description.en: The UNIX timestamp indicating when the channel was created. Data from the last 30 days can be queried. The value is expressed as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.

description.zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
> 如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据。
description.en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used.
> If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned.

description.zh:
统计维度。取值：
- **OS**：按照系统统计。
- **SDK_VERSION**：按照SDK版本统计。
description.en:
Statistical dimension. Valid values:
- **OS**: Statistics by operating system.
- **SDK_VERSION**: Statistics by SDK version.

title.zh: 获取频道分布统计数据

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于获取频道分布统计数据。您可以按系统类型或SDK版本不同维度统计数据。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To
This API is used to obtain channel distribution statistics. You can collect statistics by dimension, such as system type or SDK version.
### Queries per second (QPS) limit
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be rate-limited, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.
